dump_tensor: dump a torch tensor to a file with metadata, tags, and optional gradient information
dump_model_parameters: dump all model parameters and their gradients as separate tensor files for debugging
configure_dumper_http: configure the dumper remotely via HTTP POST to enable, set filter, or reset state
register_non_intrusive_hooks: register forward hooks on a model to automatically dump inputs and outputs of each layer
dump_tensor_info: get a string summary of a tensor including shape, dtype, device, min, max, mean, and samples
